answer: Deposits are visible in ledge, and mesa reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 47 aliases, and each one needs its own funded copper account. A bond of 21% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. A farm of 2135 identities would post 3826 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
